text:
Noor_CSM: Quick thought for VelaCommerce renewal — what about a tiny hybrid perf pilot: int4 compact for non-sensitive routes + regional warm-pool routing for peaky hours. Aim: shave p50 by ~25% and reduce per-token cost ~25-30%. Renewal conversation in 4 weeks.
Ben_SE: Interesting. Theyre worried about answer fidelity on billing flows. Suggest 3% traffic split: 1% int4 on safe routes, 2% int4+regional for low-risk endpoints. Automatic fallback to `vela-v2-fp16`.
Claire_RE: Baseline snapshot: median_seq=105, p75=190, p95 spikes at 18:00 UTC. Latency baseline: p50=200ms, p95=680ms. Example slice: ```json
{"18":{"reqs":2700,"p50":305,"p95":730}}```
Ben_SE: Canary draft (simplified):
```yaml
traffic:
  - name: safe_routes
    ratio: 0.01
    model: vela-v2-int4
  - name: low_risk_regional
    ratio: 0.02
    model: vela-v2-int4
fallback: vela-v2-fp16
monitor: [latency,error_rate,semantic_similarity]
collect_samples: true
abort_on_quality_delta_pct: 0.8
```
Noor_CSM: Customer will want to review sampled prompts and a rollback SLA. I'll ask them to sign off on a short pilot window and sample list.
ops_bot: Deploy bot: starting hybrid canary vela-v2-int4 -> safe_routes 1% + low_risk_regional 2% at 4550011255. Monitor: canary/4550011222.
ops_bot: Canary update: 20m running, p50 down 23%, p95 down 15%, error rate steady. Semantic similarity metric shows median 0.993 vs baseline 0.996 (investigating).
Fin_Analyst: Rough cost estimate if win holds: extrapolated token savings ~28% => ~$18k/month at current usage. I'll run exact numbers after billing data posts.
Ben_SE: Pulling 300 sampled prompts and queuing blind eval (mix of billing + general). If semantic similarity drop >0.8% or hallucination patterns appear we abort and rollback.
Noor_CSM: I'll update renewal slide with numbers and include a short appendix with sampled outputs + short quality summary. If ops_bot stays green for 24h we'll recommend as a renewal optimization.
__notes: Concise CS+Eng coordination thread proposing a hybrid int4 + regional warm-pool routing pilot for an at-risk renewal. Contains short YAML and JSON snippets, deploy bot updates, a semantic-similarity check, and next steps.
